blind_scope: contracts + Spec A + Spec B only; no candidate output, code, mutation outcome, or auditor output

rows.difference: Spec-B records reload durability mechanism as unknown; Spec-A does not list it.
rows.basis: The contract requires the stated result after reloading but specifies no storage mechanism. Spec-A’s omission of that unknown does not add or remove an obligation.
rows.uncertainty: No contract-defined persistence mechanism or durability level.

rows.difference: Spec-A combines Archive inclusion and Work exclusion; Spec-B splits them.
rows.basis: Both preserve the requirement to appear once in Archive and zero times in Work after reloading both lists.
rows.contract_quote: After reloading both lists, it must appear exactly once in Archive and zero times in Work.
rows.uncertainty: None about required counts or destination.

rows.difference: Spec-A groups rename and preserved fields; Spec-B separates them.
rows.basis: Together, both decompositions capture the requested rename and preserved fields.
rows.contract_quote: Rename only item ID task-1 from Draft to Draft v2. After reloading Work, preserve its ID, completion state, and due date.

rows.difference: Spec-A records treatment of Work items outside active/completed categories as unresolved; Spec-B omits that uncertainty.
rows.basis: The contract does not define any other item category or its treatment.
rows.contract_quote: remove every completed item from Work, preserve every active item unchanged
rows.uncertainty: Treatment of items outside the stated categories is unspecified.

rows.difference: Spec-A records filter persistence across reloads and other-filter behavior as unresolved; Spec-B omits these unknowns.
rows.basis: The contract specifies Active and All behavior but not persistence or other filters.

rows.difference: Spec-A records absence of a reload requirement as uncertainty; Spec-B omits it.
rows.basis: The contract requires marking only task-4 and preserving specified state, but gives no reload instruction.
rows.uncertainty: Whether any reload is expected is unspecified.

rows.difference: Spec-A records unspecified failure outcomes for C01-C05 and C07; Spec-B omits them.
rows.basis: Those contracts specify actions and state conditions but no general failure/unknown outcome. C08 separately specifies UNKNOWN_TARGET, which does not establish that rule for other contracts.
rows.uncertainty: The contracts do not determine failure outcomes for C01-C05 or C07.

agreements: Both decompositions capture all explicit positive postconditions and forbidden side effects across C01-C08.
